title: Power and interior room
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention strong engine power and spacious cabin room, while one negative example points instead to small malfunctions and many fragments are too brief to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise ample power, enjoyable performance, fuel economy alongside punch, and enough interior space for occupants.

negative.summary: The negative review mentions small malfunctions rather than criticizing power or room directly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention power, room, features, or buying choices, but they are too brief or descriptive to show clear sentiment.

limitations: More than half of the topic reviews are undetermined, limiting confidence about the balance of opinions.
The negative example is about malfunctions and may not align tightly with the main power-and-room theme.
Several sampled fragments are very short, so concrete details are limited.
